chapter: Ellington colleagues, singers and world tours
title: Ellington's best singers
summary: Ivie Anderson fit the band best and Kay Davis was distinctively cultured.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: We've mentioned very few of the singers. We've talked a little bit about Ivy and we've mentioned Kay Davis but there were a long succession of singers. No one stayed very long, I guess Ivy stayed long, didn't she. How about some of those singers? Who do you think were the outstanding ones?

Well, most definitely it was Ivie Anderson, she fit perfectly with the band her voice was of the sultry type that fit the band perfectly. And I would say the next one -- the one that was different was Kay Davis because her's was a cultured, very fine, cultured voice and after that well just take your pick.
